JUDGES' REMUNERATION ACT 1971

JupGEs' REMUNERATION (AMENDMENT OF SCHEDULES)

REGULATIONS 1997

In exercise of the powers conferred by section 19 of the Judges'
Remuneration Act 1971, the Yang di-Pertuan Agong, after consultation
with the Chief Justice, makes the following regulations:

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Judges' Remuneration

(Amendment of Schedules) Regulations 1997.

(2) Paragraph 4(a) shall be deemed to have come into force on

1 January 1995.

(3) Paragraphs 4(b), (c), (d) and (e) shall be deemed to have

come into force on 1 January 1996.

2. The Judges' Remuneration Act 1971, which in these Regulations
is referred to as the "Act", is amended by substituting for the First

Schedule the following Schedule:
